tells.1: Stock warmth: 'part of our community' and 'makes your desk a little more colourful.'
tells.2: Layered conversational padding: 'something new to share,' 'Thanks for being with us,' and 'No pressure.'
tells.3: Manufactured intrigue in 'quietly working on something'; 'nothing else to pay' also introduces an unsupported assurance.
tells.4: The summary bullets repeat the preceding paragraph, while multiple expressions of gratitude feel formulaic.
tells.6: Repeated product details, repeated thanks, and an overlong reassurance in the P.S. resemble template padding.

reason: Version 5 gives customers the essentials and a clear next step without laboured enthusiasm; I would soften 'never' to avoid overpromising. These rankings assess editorial effectiveness and human feel, not actual authorship.
